Date Range Picker

The Date Range Picker captures a start and end date in one gesture. Click the field to open a month calendar, pick the start, then the end — the span highlights with zak-in-range.

Basic Range Picker

Open the popup, click two days. Days between the endpoints are highlighted and the field shows Sept 1 — Sept 12.

Pick a start, then an end.

HTML
<div class="zak-range-picker">
    <button class="zak-range-field">
        <span data-start>Start date</span>
        <span class="zak-range-sep">&mdash;</span>
        <span data-end>End date</span>
    </button>
    <div class="zak-range-popup">
        <!-- .zak-calendar built by JS -->
    </div>
</div>

Quick Presets

Offer ready-made spans. Chips such as Today, Last 7 days or This month set the selection immediately.

Choose a preset or pick a range.

HTML
<div class="zak-docs-presets" role="group" aria-label="Quick ranges">
    <button class="zak-preset-chip" data-days="7">Last 7 days</button>
    <button class="zak-preset-chip" data-days="0">Today</button>
    <button class="zak-preset-chip" data-month>This month</button>
</div>
<div class="zak-calendar" id="range2"></div>

Constrained Range

Disable days outside a business window with the disabled attribute so the picker rejects invalid spans functionally, not just visually.

HTML
// During grid construction:
if (date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6) {
    day.disabled = true;   // block weekends
}
if (date < new Date(2026, 8, 15)) {
    day.disabled = true;   // block past bookings
}

Value Handling

Keep two hidden inputs (start/end) for form submission, and mirror the readable value in the field.

HTML
<input type="hidden" name="date_from">
<input type="hidden" name="date_to">

<script>
    function commitRange(start, end) {
        form.date_from.value = toISO(start);
        form.date_to.value   = toISO(end);
        field.textContent = short(start) + ' \u2014 ' + short(end);
    }
</script>

CSS Classes

HTML
// Range picker composition:
.zak-range-picker       /* Relative wrapper (field + popup) */
.zak-range-field        /* Readable trigger (styled as a field) */
.zak-range-sep          /* "—" between the two dates */
.zak-range-popup        /* Popup card (hidden until active) */
.zak-preset-row         /* Quick-range chip row */
.zak-preset-chip        /* Single preset button */

// Calendar states (shared with Calendar):
.zak-calendar-day.zak-in-range    /* Days inside the span */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-range-start /* Start endpoint */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-range-end   /* End endpoint */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-today       /* Current day */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-outside     /* Adjacent-month days */
.zak-calendar-day:disabled        /* Unselectable days */

// Toggle class:
.zak-range-popup-active  /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript

HTML
// No library module ships for the range picker — reuse the
// Calendar helpers and add two-state selection:

var start = null, end = null;

function onDayClick(dayBtn) {
    var date = new Date(dayBtn.dataset.date);
    if (!start || end) {          // first pick / starting over
        start = date; end = null;
    } else if (date < start) {     // picked earlier than start
        end = start; start = date;
    } else {
        end = date;
    }
    drawRange();
}

function drawRange() {
    grid.forEach(day => day.classList.toggle('zak-in-range',
        start && end && day.date > start && day.date < end));
    mark(start, 'zak-range-start');
    mark(end, 'zak-range-end');
}

Accessibility

  • Make the trigger a <button> (not a div) so it is focusable and operable by keyboard.
  • Announce the selection: set the field text on each choice, or use an aria-live="assertive" line.
  • Keep hidden start/end inputs labelled so the pair reads clearly to assistive tech.
  • Preset chips labeled Last 7 days etc. are more descriptive than raw dates.
